description_html:
Since I've been bored (as usual) I decided if I can try to put an EOTech on a SCAR, so yeah this was made. This is actually my first compile so tips would be appreciated. I noticed there were smoothing errors, since I'm new to this I have no idea how to fix it. I also did a recolor on the SCAR to make it look more tan and I added a tan color on the EOTech. I'm not really sure if that's how a EOTech should look big. Anyways enjoy my first!


No pee, wee's. I'm new to this so don't keep on asking me to make one.

UPDATE!!
